notes.title: Official Release | The Mist of Truth Has Finally Cleared...
notes.content:
"Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn..."

Brave explorers, or rather, souls about to step into the abyss of madness:

After a long development and countless battles with unknown forces, Whisper of Y'Ryando is finally ready to unveil its mysterious veil to the world. Today, the door to the misty world of Cthulhu is officially open for you — welcome to Zivada City.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255870/_/

[h2]🎲 Roll your fate, Unveil the Truth[/h2]

[h3]A Unique Dice-Based Clue System[/h3]

The dice of fate roll in your hands, and each throw may reveal a new fragment of the truth. In this world full of randomness, you never know where your next discovery will lead — will it bring you closer to the truth, or deeper into madness?

[h3]Hundreds of Clues Await Discovery[/h3]

From mysterious symbols on the walls of ancient buildings to the vague whispers that reach you in the dead of night, every clue is a piece of the puzzle. Seemingly unrelated fragments, when pieced together by you, will slowly form the outline of an unspeakable truth.

[h3]The Core Concept of TOC[/h3]

Collecting clues is just the beginning. The real challenge lies in how to stitch together these seemingly chaotic pieces into a complete story. Every connection could change your understanding of the entire event, and each inference might lead you to a different ending.

[h2]🌟 Are You Ready?[/h2]

To thank our players' ongoing support and valuable feedback, we’re offering a 40% launch discount. We also invite you to join our community and help us improve and refine the game!

Now, the gates to Whisper of Y'Ryando are open for you. Roll the dice, collect the clues, and piece together a truth that perhaps should never have been known. But remember—some knowledge comes at a cost that may be heavier than ignorance.

"That is not dead which can eternal lie.
And with strange aeons, even death may die."

👇👇👇
